version.value: Original four-part instrumental dance; sounding pitch approximately A=415
version.note: The file identifies the Act V Chaconne. Approximate pitch is inferred by comparing its written C-major ending with the recording’s prominent sustained peaks near 494–495 Hz, about a semitone below modern C5. The session source does not state a tuning reference; no exact temperament or edition is claimed.
